result.mechanismLaw: THE CONTAINER TREE replaces all three mechanisms: one viewport binding (.app-layout 100dvh, promoted to `container: frame / size` — definite by construction), then geometry adapts only through containers — the producer's InstrumentChassis IS the scene container for the eight instrument routes (verified in the installed glass-ui 7.0.0 dist: typed golden/preview-dominant fr-ratios, its own @container narrow arm at 44.9375rem stacking stage→inspector→action, cqi interior rhythm), interiors prefer queryless fluidity (auto-fit/auto-fill minmax, clamp, cqi/cqb), :has() covers presence, JS holds no breakpoint (useBreakpoint/[data-layout]/mobilePaneIndex/v-if dual tree all die), @media survives only for preference/capability queries — width/aspect @media = 0 (7 today), lg:* = 0 (12 today). result.modelObserved: claude-opus-5[1m] — Opus 5, 1M context. Declared seat (L-11), not inherited; executed solo and blind to worker-F.
result.mechanismLaw: ML-0: ONE mechanism — the region's own box. Every layout decision is a function of the containing box, never the viewport; the viewport is read for exactly two block-axis reservations (100svh shell floor, 40svh persistent-stage ceiling). THE DECISIVE FIND: the one mechanism ALREADY SHIPS and has zero demo consumers — glass-ui 7.0.0's InstrumentChassis (node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/instrument-chassis/styles.css) already declares container-type:inline-size, drives all six S122 spacing values off cqi clamps, collapses stage/inspector at @container (max-width:44.9375rem) — a CONTAINER query — and expresses golden/preview-dominant as UNBOUNDED minmax(0,61.8034fr)/minmax(0,38.1966fr). grep -c InstrumentChassis demo/ = 0. So the design is overwhelmingly a deletion. Sub-laws: ML-1 container-type:inline-size and `size` is REFUSED (contain:size would forbid the narrow document-scroll sequence canon §3 law 6 requires — a facility rejected for what it breaks); ML-2 svh for reservations / dvh for fills / lvh never (measured: svh count = 0 today, shell is height:100dvh); ML-3 @media survives only for CAPABILITY not size (2 of the 7 size queries are capability questions wearing a width: ConsoleRail's max-width:1023px touch rung is (pointer:coarse), DockStatusLamp's min-width:1024px is @container dock — and glass ALREADY ships those dock rules, the demo just never passed container-name="dock", so two producer rules are dead code today); ML-4 intrinsic sizing before any query (minmax/clamp/auto-fit/aspect-ratio/fr); ML-5 :has() + [data-has-inspector] replace the JS layout question; ML-6 logical properties, with overflow-block support flagged as an unverified unknown (no browserslist, no vite target). MEASURED CENSUS CORRECTED: MT-F028's "34 @media" is the total; only 7 are viewport-dimension queries (the other 27 are prefers-*/forced-colors/print/pointer/hover and must survive). The real RED is 7 viewport @media + 58 Tailwind sm:/md:/lg: prefixes + 37 JS breakpoint refs = 102 adaptation sites expressing 2 thresholds in 3 incompatible dialects. Net after: 102 sites -> 1 mechanism; 7 viewport @media -> 0; 58 prefixes -> 0; 37 JS refs -> 0; 4 layout tokens -> 1; PaneSegmentedControl.vue (52 LoC) deleted; shell.css layout rules ~90 -> ~35; ZERO new demo abstractions (no wrapper components, no shared/ dir).
result.ultrawideLaw: UL-1: no route's stage is bounded by a viewport-independent constant — --pane-max, --content-max-h and the 21/9 aspect arm are DELETED outright (the scene band's own grid row is the honest cap, as foundation.css:427's own comment already asserts). UL-2: surplus is SPENT in a stated order and only the last resort is margin — (1) the protagonist grows (stages are fr with aspect-ratio; a 2080px meniscus at 3440 is strictly better than 512px, because a colour field's job is precision and precision is pixels); (2) fields gain COLUMNS via repeat(auto-fill, minmax(<slip>,1fr)) — surplus becomes density, and auto-fill stops minting tracks when content runs out so it degrades to (1) automatically; (3) measure-bound regions hold at 66ch/comfort and hand the surplus BACK to (1)/(2), never to page gutter (mechanically this is glass ask G-3, not a demo cap — a demo max-inline-size on the inspector would be the --pane-max mistake at a smaller scale); (4) the gutter is fluid and bounded: --app-gutter: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5cqi, 3rem) = 48px/side at 3440 = 2.8%, earned breathing room. UL-3: the coverage gate is ROUTE-CLASSED because a 2240px paragraph is also a defect — stage/field compositions (16 of 18) gate at >=90% content-width coverage AND >=90% scene-band block extent at 3440x1440; measure-bound (/about, recovery) are EXEMPT from coverage and instead gate at article inline-size in [60ch,72ch] AND zero zero-content companion boxes (the actual sin at 3440 is not a narrow column, it is a narrow column with an empty glass pane beside it). UL-4: aspect ratio never selects a layout — both min-aspect-ratio arms die; the D6-03 portrait pathology they existed for is answered by the container (a 1080-wide slab gives the chassis ~1030px > 719px so it stays two-column, which on a 1750px-tall screen is CORRECT; the pathology was an artifact of --content-max-h capping the pair at 52rem). NEW MEASUREMENT this seat added: the ultrawide cap is TWO-AXIS, not one — at 3440x1440 aspect 2.389 crosses 21/9 and fires --content-max-h: clamp(30rem,62dvh,38rem) = 608px, so the stage is 30.5% of width AND 45.4% of the scene band's height = ~86% of viewport area dead. MT-F028 reported the inline axis only.

result.headline: The one adaptation mechanism the charter asks for is already installed and has zero consumers: glass-ui 7.0.0's InstrumentChassis already ships container-type, cqi spacing, a CONTAINER-query collapse at 44.9375rem, and exact UNBOUNDED golden/preview-dominant fr ratios — so the design is overwhelmingly a DELETION (102 adaptation sites across 3 dialects -> 1 mechanism; 7 viewport @media / 58 Tailwind prefixes / 37 JS breakpoint refs all -> 0; ~107 net lines removed; zero new demo abstractions). Two measurements sharpen MT-F028's RED: the ultrawide cap is TWO-AXIS (3440x1440 fires the 21/9 arm -> --content-max-h 608px, giving 30.5% width x 45.4% height = ~86% of viewport area dead, not just a gutter problem), and the mobile document CANNOT SCROLL AT ALL (docScrollable=0 at every viewport, from shell.css height:100dvh + overflow:hidden) — that, not the pane router alone, is why mobile shows 7.7% of desktop content, and it makes canon §3 law 6's mandated document-scrolling sequence literally unsatisfiable today. Per-route verdict via a stated discriminator (BM-1: a route earns a bespoke narrow arm iff its controls and their observable effect are in DIFFERENT regions AND the interaction is continuous): 15 ONE-LAYOUT, 2 BESPOKE-NARROW (/blob + /atmosphere, sharing ONE 6-declaration sticky-stage rule that glass ask G-1 would reduce to zero demo lines), 1 PRODUCER-BESPOKE (Account dialog). Four born-RED waves in the FORMATION-LAWS template, each with pasted failing output: V-L1 BLOCK LAW (docScrollable 0, pcH/scene 45.4%), V-L2 ONE MOUNT (text 69 vs 893 = 7.7%, specimenChanged false at 390, 37 JS refs), V-L3 INLINE LAW (gridTemplateColumns '512px 512px' at 1440/2560/3440 = 50/50, 11.80pp off the nearest legal ratio; wCov 30.5%), V-L4 PROVING PAIR (0 of 31 sliders at 390; inspector 2605/695 = 3.7 screens). Six honest unknowns recorded rather than papered over, including overflow-block support (no browserslist in the repo), the Picker at 320, and whether the chassis' overflow:clip will amputate the HeroBlob ornament.

result.modelObserved: claude-fable-5 (Fable 5) — arbiter-F of the M-12/M-13 tri-fold per L-14; observed, not inherited (L-11 receipt). Workers adjudicated: worker-F = claude-fable-5, worker-O = claude-opus-5[1m].
result.headline: Worker-O's design is adopted as the spine and worker-F is refuted on both of his load-bearing mechanisms — the 100dvh+overflow:hidden inner-scroll frame (killed by canon §3 law 6's verbatim "document-scrolling" sequence and the same-day App adjudication's CONFIRMED D-8 traveling gate `documentElement.scrollHeight > clientHeight @390`, which F's design would leave RED forever; his `container: frame / size` root is additionally spec-incompatible with a content-growing box, which evaporates his cqb pin and U-1 with it) and the one-cut LG-1 transposition (the exact arc shape the App adjudication refused the same day: "an eleven-member transposition is an arc — L-1; 38% landing rate" — plus an L-5 double-booking of App D-1, which MT-APP-1 already BUILD-owns). Every decisive number was re-measured by this seat, not inherited: the census (58 responsive prefixes/28 files — F's "12 lg:*" under-counts mechanism B 4.8×; 37 JS refs/13 files; 7 viewport @media exact), the producer dist byte-level (chassis container-type, 44.9375rem container collapse, unbounded golden/preview-dominant fr, overflow:clip, the style-query density seam, and the dock @container rules measurably dead at containerName=0), and foundation.css:479's two-axis arithmetic (608px block cap at 3440×1440 → ~86% of viewport area dead — O's find, verified). Worker-F is harvested for four genuine contributions the spine lacked: the stage-spend gate (stage@3440 > stage@1440 — the sharpest surplus-reached-the-protagonist oracle), the admin subgrid one-truth, the threshold-as-published-contract glass ask (G-7), and the WebGL-resize rehearsal probe. The arbiter adds three catches BOTH workers missed: the T-45 oversampled-blur carrier dies silently with .pane-wrapper (the t33 rim artifact would return — re-seat + gate added to V·L2), the dock's posture under document scroll is undesigned (U-7, probe-decided in V·L1), and the band collides file-for-file with MT-APP-1 and must run after it. Final shape: 18-route table (15 ONE / 2 BESPOKE-NARROW sharing one 6-declaration rule that glass ask G-1 reduces to zero / 1 PRODUCER-BESPOKE Account dialog), ML-0..ML-7 + UL-1..UL-4 + MB-1..MB-6 + BM-1 laws, 8 merged glass asks, member-interior law binding W18–W30 with F's gates, and four born-RED waves (V·L1 block law → V·L2 one mount → V·L3 inline law → V·L4 proving pair) keyed to the committed layout-utilization.mjs probe extended in place — 102 adaptation sites in 3 dialects → 1 already-installed producer mechanism, at negative net lines and zero new demo abstractions. The workers' headline convergence (chassis-as-mechanism, 2 bespoke routes, spend-not-shed) was spot-checked for suspicious agreement and cleared: they diverge on scroll model, root container, viewport units, census, wave count, route count and ask granularity — the L-14 independence signature — and every shared claim was re-verified against bytes, canon, or the tree.
ruledDisagreements: RD-1 scroll model & root container — F's inner-scroll frame (100dvh+overflow:hidden, .pane-main scrolls, container:frame/size, cqb pin) vs O's real document scroll (min-block-size:100svh, no overflow, scene/inline-size, svh pin): RULED FOR O, F REFUTED twice — canon §3 law 6 says 'document-scrolling' verbatim; the adjudicated D-8 gate (documentElement.scrollHeight > clientHeight @390) stays RED forever under F; and contain:size is spec-incompatible with a box that must grow with content, which kills F's cqb unit and his U-1 unknown with it.

RD-2 mechanism-B census — F '12 lg:*' vs O '58 sm:/md:/lg:': RULED FOR O by arbiter re-run (58 exact; F's gate would close green with 46 prefixes alive — a vacuous L-2 gate). Correction to O: 28 files, not 19.

RD-3 wave shape — F's 3 waves with LG-1 as a one-session transposition vs O's 4 value-alone-ordered waves: RULED FOR O — the same-day App adjudication refused exactly F's shape (D-2 RESCOPED: 'an eleven-member transposition is an arc, L-1, 38% landing rate'), F's own preserved dissent in App.md argues the same, and F's LG-1 double-books App D-1 which MT-APP-1 already BUILD-owns (L-5 violation, struck).

RD-4 ultrawide gate — F's blanket 90%-except-/about vs O's route-classed two-axis UL-3: RULED FOR O's law (the 608px block-cap find is verified arithmetic; a 2240px paragraph is also a defect) WITH F's spend witness folded in as a V·L3 gate (stage@3440 > stage@1440, RED today at 512px both — coverage alone can pass with a stretched rack and starved stage).

RD-5 route table — F's 16 rows vs O's 18: RULED FOR O — canon §3.1's ratification inventory is verbatim eleven members plus ADMIN5 plus Account plus storage recovery = 18; F never issued verdicts for Account (producer Dialog, bespoke at zero demo lines) or recovery.

RD-6 pin mechanics — F's min(42cqb,24rem) vs O's sticky + aspect-ratio 3/2 + max-block-size 40svh: RULED FOR O as a consequence of RD-1 (no size container survives, so cqb would silently degrade to the small viewport anyway; svh is honest and stable under URL-bar collapse).

RD-7 interiors ownership — F's LG-3 as a layout-band wave vs O's 'interiors stay with W18–W30': RULED FOR O's ownership per the adjudicated D-2 rescope (member composition belongs to the member program), WITH F's gates adopted as the binding member-interior law IL-1..IL-4 (rack wrap ≥2 cols @3440, field density 2×, 1-col + zero h-scroll @390, admin subgrid one-truth — F's structural idea O never named); F's position preserved as the salvage-wave dissent.

RD-8 glass asks — F's 2 vs O's 6: RULED union deduped into 8 — O's G-1..G-6 all verified against the dist (no sticky arm, no inspector scroll rule, no comfort token, width-based thumb rung, no fill arm, dock rules dead at containerName=0), F's threshold-contract ask survives as G-7, and O's U-4 (chassis overflow:clip vs HeroBlob ornament + T-45 carrier) is promoted to the probe-gated G-8 candidate.
result.dissent: Preserved verbatim in the apotheosis §DISSENT: (1) worker-F's frame-law text in full — refuted at RD-1 but kept because its two advantages are real (dock persistent by construction; stable dvh) and U-7 (dock posture under document scroll) exists because of them; (2) worker-F's LG-1 COMPLETABLE claim in full — refused against the same-day arc adjudication and the measured 38% landing rate; (3) worker-F's interiors-as-wave position in full — preserved as a live objection: if the member program stalls, LG-3 is the correct salvage wave and the apotheosis is its spec; (4) worker-O's two overstatements corrected on the record (19 files → 28; 'committed alongside' → the entire band is untracked, git ls-files = 0); (5) both workers' shared silences recorded, not celebrated: neither mentioned the T-45 carrier seat, the dock scroll posture, or the MT-APP-1 file collision — three misses in two independent seats is the evidence the tri-fold needed its arbiter.
